mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 5 degrees now, clear sky. Next 24 hours: high 11, low 2.

Macedonian Prime Minister Hristijan Mickoski said he will hold meetings with financial institutions in the coming days to find a buyer for Alta Bank in Bitola.

Threats of bombs on dozens of European aircraft have surged this week, prompting flight diversions, emergency delays and heightened security at several airports.

Major U.S. technology firms are feeling increased political pressure after the midterm elections, as opposition to large data centers becomes a prominent issue.

A 22-year-old motorcyclist was killed in a crash in the village of Gjonaj near Prizren around 3 p.m., according to local authorities.

Arsenal have named Portuguese forward Carlos Forbs as a potential replacement for the injured Bukayo Saka.
